domains.name: furniture
domains.classifier_prompt: a piece of furniture such as a chair table cabinet sofa or bed

parts.planner_description: a structural load-bearing post extending from the seat, frame, or tabletop toward the floor
the short terminal pad, glide, caster, or widened end at the floor-contacting tip of a furniture leg
the upper load-bearing surface on which a person sits, attached above the legs or frame
a narrow structural brace connecting two furniture legs below the seat or tabletop

domains.name: tool_prop
domains.classifier_prompt: a handheld tool weapon firearm rifle gun instrument or utensil

parts.planner_description: a graspable handle or grip that is visibly distinct from the main tool housing; never the complete tool body
the small curved firing lever inside the trigger guard below the receiver
the small finger-operated power switch on a drill or powered tool handle, not the handle or main housing
the long narrow firing tube running forward from the receiver toward the muzzle, excluding any surrounding handguard
the rear shoulder support extending behind the receiver, often wood or polymer, including the butt end but not the pistol grip
the compact central metal action housing above the trigger and magazine, between the handguard and stock; never the whole firearm
the detachable ammunition container projecting below the receiver, commonly curved on an AK and positioned in front of the pistol grip
the hand-held downward handle behind the magazine and under the rear of the receiver
the forward casing or wooden grip surrounding the barrel between the receiver and muzzle; it does not project downward like a magazine
a small raised aiming component on the top line of the barrel or receiver
the terminal opening or device at the projectile-exit end of the barrel, not the entire front-sight assembly
the small protective loop surrounding the trigger below the receiver
a small cocking control protruding from the receiver, not the receiver housing itself
the compact tool holder between a drill housing and its bit, excluding the complete front housing
the narrow replaceable cutting or drilling tool extending from the chuck
a distinct top or side hand grip attached to a demolition hammer housing, never the long motor housing or the operator
a distinct cloth, cord, tape, or leather band wrapped around a tool handle; exclude the rigid handle, guard, and blade
the compact collar that connects a demolition hammer body to its chisel, excluding the body and chisel
the narrow replaceable steel chisel extending away from the demolition hammer tool holder

domains.name: device

parts.planner_description: a visible manufacturer emblem physically printed, embossed, or attached to the device housing
the complete rectangular display surface of the device, excluding text or graphics shown on it
the continuous physical frame surrounding the display surface

dense_prompts: keyboard area with rows of keys

parts.planner_description: one discrete physical key located within the keyboard or keypad array
planner_exclusions: text or watermark on the screen

parts.planner_description: a physical imaging module or webcam mounted in the device housing, commonly on a display bezel
a physical connector opening on an exposed outer edge or side of the device housing
planner_exclusions: mark in the middle of a screen or panel

parts.planner_description: the mechanical joint connecting two articulated device sections, such as a laptop screen and base
the complete spherical map body of a world globe, excluding the meridian ring, axle, support stem, and base
the narrow curved support hoop following the outside of a globe sphere, not a printed longitude line on the map
a small pivot or axle connecting the globe sphere to its meridian support
the narrow support between a globe sphere or meridian ring and the broad bottom base
